test_title: PYST 48: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

He is __waiting upon__ you in the compound.
solution:
The solution is **waiting for.**

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in "He is waiting upon__ you in the compound." is waiting for.
 
• Therefore **option 3 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Here the preposition **for **is the appropriate option for **upon.**
 
• We should choose correct prepositions to have a meaningful sentence.
 
• **Preposition__: ***Preposition is a word which **shows position of an object**.
 
 
• *For example : "They sat on dinning table for the dinner." , "The flowers are inside the vase." , "He left at 8'oclock."*
